description: Drives knobs and sliders of other modules in the patch from the CC controllers of a MIDI device, with no cables and no jacks
notes: nothing is driven until a MIDI device is chosen and a mapping is made
click an empty row, then click the knob to be driven, then move a control on the MIDI device; the row then names the CC number and the parameter it drives
the driver, device and channel are picked by left-clicking the three lines of the display, each of which opens a menu of its own; none of them is on the panel's right-click menu
menu: Smooth CC — slews the mapped parameter towards each new value instead of stepping to it
